g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Kernel density over 30,977 bouts from all 45 dogs, on a shared log-seconds axis, commonest behaviour first. Two humps in a row means the dog does that behaviour in two distinct ways — which is what an average bout length deletes.'

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Kernel density over 30,977 bouts from all 45 dogs, on a shared log-seconds axis, commonest behaviour first.
Two humps in a row means the dog does that behaviour in two distinct ways — which is what an average bout length deletes.

text.aria-label: t: Source: TELLTAIL MARTS.STATE_BOUTS. Densities computed by the renderer from raw bout lengths; nothing pre-binned or pre-smoothed. Log axis; x clipped at the 99.5th percentile (74 s).
